summary: DEMO-3: on S3 «Юр-предпроверка» of the linear ТЭЛ demo, the human is replaced by the AGENT — the live T-0233 motor runLegalPrecheck, run deterministically via an in-process stub LlmPort (zero paid LLM, zero Postgres). The agent produces a PrecheckOutcome and CANNOT approve (role-intake-agent has no approve grant → PDP-deny; the moat). The outcome + a D-139-safe reasoning-trace-ref are surfaced in the clickable slice via a new INS-TEL-DEMO audit instance whose S3 node renders the ACTUAL motor outcome.

deal_context_chosen.why: = T-0233's DEMO_DEAL_CONTEXT (src/__tests__/fixtures/demo-legal-precheck-contract.ts). It is the ONLY dealContext T-0233 ships a contract body (DEMO_CONTRACT_BODY — договор оказания услуг with clauses §4.2/§7.1/§11.3) AND a deterministic expected answer (DEMO_PRECHECK_ANSWER, 3 red flags) for, so S3 has real clauses to flag. A договор оказания услуг (outbound service contract) is a procurement/expense ТЭЛ — a subset of the «заявка на расход/закупку» domain (T-0218 §2), not a different class. Closes the T-0218 review-note (the slot comment was amount-only; the prior it_expense/buy kind/direction diverged from T-0233). Aligned everywhere: seed/demo/tel-scenario.ts (DEMO_DEAL/DEMO_DEAL_CONTEXT), src/runtime/legal-precheck/demo-run.ts (DEMO_LEGAL_PRECHECK_DEAL), docs/demo/T-0218-walkthrough.md.

how_agent_is_S3_actor: src/runtime/legal-precheck/demo-run.ts :: runDemoLegalPrecheck() composes the merged T-0233 motor (runLegalPrecheck) with an injected in-process DemoStubLlmPort + in-memory deps (InMemoryAuditWriter + an inMemoryTx-style carrier returning a live-configured agent_card + published instruction + ResolverDeps allow). The motor — not a human — performs the S3 legal precheck. mode='live-stub' → proceed + 3 red flags; mode='dormant' (liveEnabled=false) → defer-to-human(dormant), the honest day-1 default. The motor's single PDP (resolveFor, T-0021) and single audit sink (appendAuditEvent, T-0016) are reused — no second resolver/table/channel.
how_outcome_visible_in_slice: src/http/audit.ts adds AUDIT_SEED instance INS-TEL-DEMO (served by the existing GET /api/audit/:instanceId and the export route), built lazily + memoized from runDemoLegalPrecheck + buildLegalPrecheckSliceView. Its S3 node renders the ACTUAL outcome: an agent event «провёл юр-предпроверку → proceed» with payload out = the red-flags summary, an opaque reasoning_trace_ref in the target, and the moat event «попытка Согласовать → отказ PDP». S4 is a human card-action (approve). No new React screen — the existing slice audit screen renders it. It is an AUDIT instance, NOT a process_instances/rights_cards row, so FF-PACK-2 (8/8) is untouched.
how_moat_enforced: role-intake-agent (seed/demo/tel-scenario.ts DEMO_GRANTS_INTAKE) has read + update grants but NO approve/exec/invoke grant. demo-run.ts :: demoApproveDenied() probes the SAME single PDP: resolveFor(deps, handle, agentSubject, 'approve') → { denied:true, reason:'no_grant' } (test AC-4). The moat is structural (a missing grant in the lattice), not a post-hoc filter; approve stays a human card-action on S4. The same deny is expressible via src/core/card-action.ts (operation='approve' routes to the same resolveFor — single arbiter, FF-CA-1).
no_paid_llm_confirmed: The demo LlmPort is DemoStubLlmPort — an in-process deterministic implementation of LlmPort with NO fetch / NO SDK import / NO network path (returns the fixed demo red-flags answer). The dormant variant uses T-0233's dormantLlmPort (throws). FF-DEMO3-1 asserts no network/SDK token in demo-run.ts; FF-LP-1(b)/FF-LP-3 (no SDK / no network in src/runtime/legal-precheck/) stay green. CI/dev openai=$0. The real OpenAI adapter is deploy-time only (RL-3, founder-gated) and is NOT touched by this task.
